The issue says this gap does not block activation, and option C adds nothing over the handoff that already exists.
Q2: The agents.md wording is the text already handed to the operator, and it is the more precise one. It says what the poller does with the marker ("links it as the item's implementation PR"), cites #3817 (mention-only PRs are rejected) and keeps `Refs #N` for the tracking issue. Option C would say the tracking-issue point twice.
